spec.highest_priority: P1 launch configuration, pinned versions and deadline continuity

findings.title: Controller build launches omit configuration overrides reported by the account owner
findings.reason: Primary reproduced: effective model account, native argv only --no-daemon; shared configuration promise requires actual launch parity

findings.title: Adding an unused function version invalidates existing flow runs
findings.reason: Primary reproduced stale_condition_registry after adding predicate@2 to a run pinned to predicate@1; future-only editing contract violated

findings.title: Wall-clock rollback extends cumulative flow deadlines
findings.reason: Primary reproduced a max_seconds1 flow dispatching after100 to99 rollback; original cumulative budgets require continuity or explicit hold

findings.title: Foreach per-iteration time/token limits are rejected and unaccounted
findings.reason: Primary compile reproduction unsupported_flow_node; spec requires independent child bounds tightening parents

findings.title: SQLite owner failures leave a misleading fresh running scheduler heartbeat
findings.reason: Reviewer constructor-failure seam reproduced twice; operational visibility requirement applies to scheduled recovery as well as wakes; regression must use real corrupt/locked private store

findings.title: Duplicated Linux transport accepts oversized unbounded JSON responses
findings.reason: Concrete divergence from bounded portable client; accept a bounded shared transport fix, not speculative architecture rewrite; smell classification remains judgement
